prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ONLY_CWT_catboost leads in seasonality capture (0.466). Catboost dominates overall RMSE (141.13) with strong late-horizon performance. High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 24.4) and concept drift suggest STL-hierarchical stacking with mixed weighting to exploit complementary trend/seasonality strengths while handling autocorrelated residuals.
